text:
Maya: Quick thought — can we do a 90min mini-retreat tomorrow to sync on playbook windows for the upcoming onboarding wave? We're seeing multiple playbooks fire in the same 24h window and customers get duplicate touches. :grimacing:
Julian: yes pls, this is creating noise in renewal signals. when's the wave?
Maya: wave goes live Tue 09:00 PT (heavy cohort of trial-to-paid). I want to coordinate playbook schedules, priority tiers, and backoff logic.
Priya: I can bring a short telemetry snapshot. quick stat: in last 7 days ~ 1.8k playbook triggers, ~14% duplicate touch overlap between onboarding and engagement playbooks.
Connor: Do we know which playbooks overlap most? if it's a small set we can just stagger them by 3-6 hours.
Priya: top offenders: `welcome_handoff`, `first_setup_checkin`, `trial-engagement-nudge`. here's a sample query I ran:
```
SELECT playbook, count(*) as triggers
FROM playbook_runs
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY playbook
ORDER BY triggers DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Lina: Also seeing some health score churn after duplicate touches — customers flagged as "at-risk" then cleared when multiple nudges hit. That confuses owners.
Maya: exact problem. Proposed agenda: 1) map playbook priorities 2) define stagger/backoff defaults 3) decide owner handoff rules 4) quick follow-ups (scripts + dry-run).
Julian: +1. can we include a short runbook checklist for staging verification? ops needs a quick go/no-go.
Connor: I'll add a checklist item: verify webhook idempotency and dedupe token in staging. example curl to test dedupe header:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.playbooks.internal/run -H 'X-Dedupe-Token: abc123' -d '{"account_id": 42}'
```
Maya: Perfect. Priya — can you attach the top 50 impacted accounts so we can use them as a dry-run cohort?
Priya: on it, will paste CSV to the meeting doc. includes columns: account_id, owner, last_touch, health_score_delta.
ops-bot: Reminder: playbook-staging-run scheduled: Mon 22:00 PT (automated). Reaction :white_check_mark:.
Maya: Ok locking 11:00am tomorrow, 90min. I'll create the agenda + meeting doc and add the CSV and the SQL snapshots. Please RSVP and add any extra items.
Julian: I'll invite PMs for context.
Lina: Can we reserve 15min at the end to agree rollback signals? want a quick fail-safe.
Maya: good call. add to agenda. thanks all :rocket:
Priya: RSVP'd. I'll also surface a small chart of healthscore delta by playbook so we make decisions with visuals.
Connor: I'll prep the staging checklist and handoff steps.
Maya: Great — once we have outcomes we'll update playbook automation defaults: default backoff = 6h unless high-priority, owner-based suppression if owner engaged within 12h. We'll document in the playbook runbook.
Julian: sounds good. See you tomorrow.
